environment: Dev uses development mode for detailed logging; production uses production mode for performance
features.consoleLogging: Dev enables console logging for debugging; production disables for performance
features.devBypass: Dev enables authentication bypass for testing; production MUST be false for security
features.mockData: Dev enables mock data for testing features; production MUST be false to serve real data
overrides.verboseErrorMessages: Dev enables detailed error messages for debugging; production hides sensitive info for security
devTools.enableConsoleLogger: Dev enables verbose console logging; production disables to avoid clutter
devTools.enableNetworkLogger: Dev enables network request/response logging; production disables for performance
devTools.enablePerformanceLogger: Dev enables performance metrics logging; production disables to reduce overhead
devTools.enableReduxDevTools: Dev enables Redux DevTools integration; production disables
devTools.enableReactDevTools: Dev enables React DevTools integration; production disables
featureFlags.loggerCategories.categories: Dev enables all logger categories for visibility; production filters to essential categories
featureFlags.debugLogs.enabled: Dev may enable debug logs; production typically disables
thresholds.slowScreenMs: Dev may use different thresholds for testing; production uses final tuned values
thresholds.slowRequestMs: Dev may use different thresholds for testing; production uses final tuned values
network.pingIntervalMs: Dev may use different intervals for testing; production uses optimal values
network.retryDelayMs: Dev may use different delays for faster testing; production uses longer delays for resilience
